desc: 黑颗粒台面加橙色编号体系，侧光举证六角孔与螺纹，规格矩阵收口
leaf: 不锈钢圆柱头内六角螺栓
name: 深色工业风内六角螺栓规格款

shots.intent: 用一支支等距升高的阵列一眼交代规格跨度和金属做工，抢搜索点击并定下深色工业调性。
shots.textZone: top-centre pill tag, condensed headline directly under it, hairline-ruled sub-line beneath the headline

shots.intent: 把材质、抗蚀、强度、配套四条主张压成一秒可读的图标条，完成首屏之后的利益承接。
shots.textZone: headline strip centred above four evenly spaced outlined icon frames each with one short label, plus one headline and one short body line on the #F1F0EE panel

shots.intent: 用掠射侧光把牙型深度和一致性变成可见证据，替买家回答螺纹到底深不深。
shots.textZone: one accent headline in the upper third, one short body line beneath it, the two guide arrows tied to two micro labels at the thread zone

shots.intent: 先放大普通旧件滑丝与锈斑的真实挫败，再让本品的完整牙型和六角孔做对照组。
shots.textZone: one headline band across the top, one short label per panel near its part

shots.intent: 把螺栓放回被拧紧的工作现场，让买家对号入座并确认随附工具真的咬得进去。
shots.textZone: one headline at the upper left and one sub-line beneath it

shots.intent: 干净浅灰版面上单支全貌加三条要点，把做工主张逐条落到可视部位。
shots.textZone: headline and one body line centred above, three stacked label rows each led by a solid #E8940F square dot along the right side

shots.intent: 俯视 2x2 圆角矩阵加色点与规格胶囊，让买家一眼挑到想要的尺寸组合。
shots.textZone: headline centred at the top, one row of finish swatch dots beneath it, one solid pill label under each tile

shots.intent: 用三个编号格把六角孔、头颈过渡、端面滚花拍到无可辩驳，代替空洞的资质背书。
shots.textZone: one section headline on a #0B0B0C band, then per panel one numbered square badge with a short label and one body line in the right-side wedge

shots.intent: 四条购前须知加一枚按钮收尾，用清楚的服务边界而不是促销噱头降低下单顾虑。
shots.textZone: section headline centred at the top, four stacked square-bullet rows each with a short heading and one body line, one solid #E8940F pill button at the lower area

style.backgroundSystem: alternating full-width bands: #0B0B0C studio void with fine dust-particle bokeh, and #F1F0EE neutral panel with #FFFFFF rounded tiles; depth always shallow and uncluttered
style.direction: industrial machined-fastener ecommerce, dark technical catalogue with one warm accent
style.iconSystem: thin 1px line icons inside rounded-square frames on #0B0B0C, plus solid square numbered badges in #E8940F with light numerals; no filled pictograms, no 3D icons
style.lightingSystem: single hard raking key from the left, specular streaks along machined thread crests and knurled rims, deep falloff to #0B0B0C, crisp contact shadow under every part, 5000K on scene screens; no fill flattening the texture
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: premium industrial machined-fastener ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of graphite-black #0B0B0C, charcoal grit surface #1A1A1C, neutral light panel #F1F0EE, clean #FFFFFF rounded tiles, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D, and exactly one accent #E8940F; neutral tone with that single warm accent; bold condensed geometric sans-serif headlines with hairline vertical rules and rounded pill tags; alternating dark-band and light-band layout system with thin 1px outlined rounded-square icon frames and solid square numbered accent badges; hard raking side light from the left producing specular streaks along machined thread crests and knurled head rims, deep falloff into #0B0B0C, fine dust-particle bokeh, and a real contact shadow under every part; bare machined stainless-steel material rendering with visible thread flanks and hexagonal drive recesses, no coatings, no paint; stable product scale, aligned rows, no perspective warp of straight shanks; no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented numbers or badges.
noDrift: no palette changes and no extra accent hues
no mixed fonts or serif or handwritten lettering
no mismatched icon weights or badge shapes
no painted, plated or coloured coatings on the parts
no rendered numbers, grades or certifications
style.presentationRules: parts presented as an aligned ascending ladder or a tight diagonal cluster; identical scale within a screen; drive recess and thread crest are the two faces that must read; straight shanks never curved or tapered by the lens
style.surfaceSystem: #1A1A1C fine-grit metal-filing strip in the lower third of dark screens, matte #F1F0EE board on light screens, brushed machined steel as the only material read
style.typography: bold condensed geometric sans-serif headlines with hairline vertical rules, rounded pill tags with 1px outlines, small tracked body lines; one family only, Chinese copy always wrapped in corner brackets
